If you stand next to each other, it will trigger a special effect. Currently, it will only work for a couple comprised of one male and one female character.

1112006.desc: This is the best way to express "Love is a battlefield!"  When purchased, enter the name of the character you're being a couple with, then the item works for both. When the two are together, an effect comes out. Also, it can only be that of one male and one female character.

1113344.name: Challenger Ring of Restraint
1113344.h1: #c[Special Skill Ring] Ring of Restraint Lv. 1#
1113344.h2: #c[Special Skill Ring] Ring of Restraint Lv. 2#
1113344.h3: #c[Special Skill Ring] Ring of Restraint Lv. 3#
1113344.h4: #c[Special Skill Ring] Ring of Restraint Lv. 4#
1113344.h5: #c[Special Skill Ring] Ring of Restraint Lv. 5#
1113344.desc:
Creates a zone in which your Attack Power and Magic ATT are increased upon using the skill. This zone is not destroyed when you move outside it, but the Attack Power and Magic ATT increase effects are only applied while you stay within it. Using the skill again repositions the zone based on your current location.
#cEquip a Lv. 4 or higher Ring of Restraint to unlock an additional special skill ring slot that a passive special skill ring can be equipped to.##
#cChallenger World-exclusive item.
Cannot World Leap while owned.#
#cCannot be polished.#

1113345.name: Challenger Continuous Ring
1113345.desc:
Upon equipping the Continuous Ring, you will have 120 seconds of preparation time. Once the time has ended, using skills (with some exceptions) will temporarily increase your Attack Power, Magic ATT, and Boss Damage.
#cEquip a Lv. 4 or higher Continuous Ring to unlock an additional special skill ring slot that an active special skill ring can be equipped to.##
#cChallenger World-exclusive item.
Cannot World Leap while owned.#
#cCannot be polished.#

1113346.name: Challenger Weapon Jump S Ring

1113346.h2: #c[Special Skill Ring] Weapon Jump S Ring Lv. 2#
1113346.h3: #c[Special Skill Ring] Weapon Jump S Ring Lv. 3#
1113346.h4: #c[Special Skill Ring] Weapon Jump S Ring Lv. 4#
1113346.h5: #c[Special Skill Ring] Weapon Jump S Ring Lv. 5#
1113346.desc:
Temporarily increases STR by part of the main weapon's base Attack Power or Magic ATT when using skills. (Apply the higher value between the main weapon's Attack Power and Magic ATT.)
For Demon Avenger, HP increases proportionately to the main stats' increase amount.

#cChallenger World-exclusive item.
